title: Ribasim v2026.1.1 allocation low-storage-factor mechanism under BMI infiltration
purpose: Explain why current-boundary BMI infiltration is physically effective but does not reduce the fixed-grid t=0 UserDemand allocation by observing and intervening on the exact release allocation LP.
hypotheses: The allocation layer does receive the injected vertical-flux value: implicit_negative_forcing_volume is approximately 7.9999147 m3 over the one-day allocation horizon.

With low_storage_factor free, lexicographic demand objectives retain the 32 m3/day root allocation and the LP drives the Basin low_storage_factor to approximately zero, neutralizing the negative forcing in the allocation water balance.
The priority-1 LevelDemand can therefore remain satisfied in the allocation forecast even though the physical layer later realizes the full infiltration.
When the same low_storage_factor variable is fixed to 1, the root allocation falls to approximately 24.0000853 m3/day while external remains zero.
The DUMMY-20H/H2 behavior is therefore not missing BMI data but a mismatch between allocation-layer adjustable low-storage forcing and the physical realization factor for this state.
forbidden: the low_storage_factor=1 case is a diagnostic LP intervention, not a production prescription
no production defect classification before this mechanism is qualified
no reuse of later f965 allocation semantics
